Date: 2026-06-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: KVLog cleansing request — tenant: acme-corp

Hi Kimberly,

We need Redwood to remove all prompt/response artifacts, KV logs and associated inference traces for our tenant 'acme-corp' generated prior to 2026-06-01 as part of a regulatory data minimization request. Please confirm the exact scope you will purge (prompt inputs, model outputs, KV cache snapshots, runtime traces, and any related snapshots from your internal telemetry), estimated ETA for completion, and what evidence you will provide (manifest with checksums, S3 paths, and a signed attestation).

We are targeting a compliance closure for our internal audit by end of day Friday. Let me know if that timeline is feasible or if we need to prioritize a scoped subset first.

Thanks,
Daniel Ortiz
Head of Security, Acme, Inc.
security@acmeinc.com

Daniel — thanks for the clear ask. We can take this on. High-level plan: 1) Ops will run a scoped erase for tenant id 'acme-corp' covering (a) prompt inputs, (b) generated outputs, (c) KV cache snapshots tied to that tenant, and (d) ephemeral runtime traces retained in our tokenized logs. We will not touch model weights or shared telemetry used for platform health. 2) Ops will produce a CSV manifest with removed object keys and SHA256 checksums, and a short command-output log showing deletion success. 3) We will provide a signed attestation PDF and, if you need, a DocuSign envelope.

Connor — can you slot this for today, do the wipe, and push the manifest to the secure bucket path below once complete? Please include a short runbook excerpt and any failure/retry notes. Marissa — looping you for customer confirmation and to handle the attestation flow.

Kimberly Park
